content.query:
SELECT a.customeraccountid,A.PeriodBalanceTypeId, a.PeriodStartDate,a.Periodenddate, b.periodstartdate,b.end_date 
FROM BNKM.customeraccountperiodbalance_REMDUP_20230607 A  


LEFT JOIN (select  CustomerAccountId ,PeriodBalanceTypeId ,PeriodStartDate,max(end_date) end_date ,FinancialInstitutionId ,SourceSystemCode 
from (select CustomerAccountId ,PeriodBalanceTypeId ,PeriodStartDate ,FinancialInstitutionId ,SourceSystemCode  
,dateadd(dd,-1,LEAD(PeriodStartDate, 1 ,'2100-01-01') OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ,PeriodBalanceTypeId ,FinancialInstitutionId ,SourceSystemCode ORDER BY PeriodStartDate)) as end_date
from bnkm.customeraccountperiodbalance_REMDUP_20230607 where SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'  AND PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Total Transaction Balance of Value Date')
c group by CustomerAccountId ,PeriodBalanceTypeId ,PeriodStartDate,FinancialInstitutionId ,SourceSystemCode ) B ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = B.PeriodBalanceTypeId
AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode AND A.PeriodStartDate = B.PeriodStartDate WHERE A.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
 AND A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Total Transaction Balance of Value Date'
and a.customeraccountid ='24ff7479271e6a551486b15a7491694e' order by 3
